lines: Black water wells up through the peat. It is warm, like something breathed into it.

sign: Under the chapel the roots drink from a Rift. Ossian calls it communion.
root_deacon: Hollis: The roots eat on Tuesdays. Today is Tuesday. I checked twice.
root_deacon_intro: Hollis: Kneel. It's easier for the roots if you're already low.
root_deacon_defeat: Hollis: The roots will wait. They always wait.

lines: The moor is hungry, child. I only set the table. You came at dinner time.
Ossian: The roots have let go of the altar. They'll grow hungry. I'll grow thin. You've ruined a good sermon.
Ossian: Nell brought you here. I paid her in candles. She said it wasn't personal. Nothing on the moor is personal. It's just dinner.

ossian_intro: The moor is hungry, child. I only set the table. You came at dinner time.
ossian_defeat: The roots will forgive you. I will not. Go with their blessing, they never ask mine.
